text:
Elena (Design): dropping a mini design review for the API keys screen. goals: make rotate less scary, surface scope early, and show soft-revoke UX. mock: https://redwood/drive/keys-v2.png. please skim.:eyes:
Jorge (PM): solid. two asks: default to least-privilege scope on create, and make revoke recoverable for 24h so customers can rollback quickly.
Sam (Engineering): backend constraints: full secret shown only once at create. we can support soft-revoke (deactivate + ttl) and reactivate if within TTL.
Elena (Design): idea: reveal drawer after create with plaintext key, big CTA "Save this key now", and a required checkbox before dismiss for admin scopes.
Priya (A11y): drawer must trap focus, ESC closes, and copy success must be announced via live region. warning pills need AA contrast and an icon.
Nikhil (Backend): we'll expose `deactivated_until` and `recently_created` flags so UI can show reveal affordance for ~10s. also will log telemetry events: `console_key_copied`.
Dylan (Design Manager): rotate modal should show a short checklist and an estimated "Potential impacted services: ~N" (best-effort). make confirmation checkbox required for admin-level keys.
Maya (Support): include a tiny helper blurb in the drawer: "If you lose this key, soft-revoke and reissue within 24h." will cut down tickets.
Sam (Engineering): implement rotate modes: immediate and grace-period. grace-period keeps old key valid for X hours to allow rollouts. UI needs to surface which mode selected.
Jorge (PM): copy suggestions: primary rotate button = `Rotate and reveal` with subtext `New key shown only once; save it now.` avoid using 'copy' in primary label per a11y.
Priya (A11y): agree. add `role=alert` on irreversible warning and aria-describedby linking rotate button to modal text. toasts must use `role=status` for SR announcements.
Elena (Design): table row changes: name, scope badge, last used, actions. show inline reveal icon only when `recently_created=true`. mask otherwise as `••••1234`.
Sam (Engineering): ok. overflow menu order: Rotate, Revoke (soft), Edit metadata. menus must be keyboard-openable and focus first item.
Elena (Design): empty state copy: `No keys yet — create a key to get started.` CTA label `Create key`. include sub-tip: `Tip: create embedding-only keys to reduce blast radius.`
Dylan (Design Manager): nuance: require checkbox only for keys with admin scope; low-privilege keys skip to avoid friction. A/B test later.
Jorge (PM): telemetry: tag events with `created_from=console|api`, `action_source=drawer|table|modal`, and `scope` for funnel analysis.
Elena (Design): I'll push updated mocks with drawer + rotate modal and soft-revoke banner in ~2hrs. console-bot: reminder 150 sync in 90m, add mocks before meeting. :calendar:
